gloss: to stock; to have a full selection; to get everything together

definitions.gloss: to stock (a range of items); to have a full selection available
definitions.explanation: To carry or maintain a comprehensive variety of products or goods for sale. Commonly used in retail and commercial contexts to describe a shop's inventory.

definitions.gloss: to gather and prepare (documents, items needed)
definitions.explanation: To collect and assemble all the necessary items or documents so that everything required is ready and complete.

examples.japanese: {各種|かくしゅ}サイズを{取|と}り{揃|そろ}えております。
examples.english: We have all sizes in stock.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{商品|しょうひん}を{幅広|はばひろ}く{取|と}り{揃|そろ}えています。
examples.english: We stock a wide range of seasonal products.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{輸入|ゆにゅう}ワインを{豊富|ほうふ}に{取|と}り{揃|そろ}えている。
examples.english: This shop has a rich selection of imported wines.

examples.japanese: {必要|ひつよう}な{書類|しょるい}を{取|と}り{揃|そろ}えてください。
examples.english: Please gather all the necessary documents.

examples.japanese: {申請|しんせい}に{必要|ひつよう}なものを{全|すべ}て{取|と}り{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: I got everything needed for the application together.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{準備|じゅんび}で{持|も}ち{物|もの}を{取|と}り{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: I gathered my belongings in preparation for the trip.

notes:
A compound verb formed from {取|と}る (to take) and {揃|そろ}える (to arrange, to make uniform). Sense 1 is commonly used in retail and commercial contexts to describe having a variety of products available. Sense 2 means to collect and prepare everything that is needed.

USAGE:
Sense 1 is very common in polite commercial speech, often in the ている/ております form to describe what a shop carries. Sense 2 is used more generally when preparing or assembling items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商品|しょうひん}を{取|と}り{揃|そろ}える: to stock products
- {書類|しょるい}を{取|と}り{揃|そろ}える: to gather documents
- {豊富|ほうふ}に{取|と}り{揃|そろ}える: to have a rich selection
- {幅広|はばひろ}く{取|と}り{揃|そろ}える: to stock a wide range

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {揃|そろ}える: to arrange, to put in order — more general, without the nuance of gathering from various sources
- {品揃|しなぞろ}え: product lineup — noun form describing the range of goods available
- {用意|ようい}する: to prepare — more general preparation, not specifically gathering a variety
